scope: Proposed office operational finance contract; no production posting implementation, statutory tax determination or legal accounting compliance claim.

constraints.rule: Agreement terms, posted charges, cash, allocations and reversals are distinct records; no agreement/charge creation implies cash.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: All business references, idempotency identities and correction groups are office-scoped; fresh membership and explicit action authority are required.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Ordinary posted amounts are strictly positive exact decimals; reject zero/negative/non-finite values and binary float input. Internal signed effects are service-derived.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Transfer source and destination are distinct same-office accounts; both legs commit or neither; operating totals exclude them.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Allocation office, counterparty, direction and currency match both source cash and target obligation; neither side can be over-allocated.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Client receipt 120 against charges 100 retains 20 credit; partial settlement 25 against 100 retains 75 outstanding.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Posted originals are immutable. Corrections retain original IDs, actor, reason, effective date and linked reversals; no silent admin edit/delete.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Cancellation is explicit and is never overwritten by settlement recomputation.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: A unique reviewed source identity prevents duplicated recurring/task charges; generation is after commit and safely retried.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: Office fee/cash amounts are never a proxy for the client's imported myDATA turnover or statutory tax liability.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: A reversal or allocation release is visible at its own effective date; historical as-of calculations never remove the original solely because it is now reversed.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

constraints.rule: A failed operation, insufficient credit, stale balance or repeated mismatched idempotency key leaves no partial money, allocation or audit effect.
constraints.basis: Existing requirements; technical/business acceptance still Pending

decisions.proposed_rule: An approved signed account opening is the balance at the start of its effective date. Include movements on that date; reject earlier postings and show no established balance before it. Existing debt/credit is a separately reviewed opening obligation/credit, never a second cash opening. After use, correct an opening through an attributable adjustment, not by overwriting history.
alternatives_for_review: Choose another precise opening convention and revise the dated examples.
Confirm whether negative openings and overdrafts are permitted.

decisions.title_el: Περίοδοι χρέωσης, προθεσμίες και αναλογία μήνα
decisions.proposed_rule: Monthly schedules use calendar-month source keys and an explicit due-date rule (day 1–28 for the first implementation). Starts/ends during a month require an explicitly reviewed first/last-period amount; no automatic proration is assumed. A confirmed agreement/period has one charge source, regardless of retry or scheduler. One-off charges require explicit effective and due dates.
alternatives_for_review: Approve an exact daily proration/day-count and month-end rule before implementing it.
Choose another billing anchor and due-date convention.

decisions.proposed_rule: The accountant explicitly confirms charge/amount allocations. An optional oldest-due-first preview requires confirmation; no hidden allocation on saving cash. Enforce same office, counterparty, currency and receivable/payable direction. A deterministic preview sorts by due date, posting date, then immutable ID.
alternatives_for_review: Approve automatic oldest-due-first allocation with an exact cancellation/retry rule.

decisions.title_el: Πιστωτικό πελάτη, προκαταβολή προμηθευτή και επιστροφές
decisions.proposed_rule: A client overpayment stays as unallocated receipt credit. Mirror this for supplier payments as an unallocated supplier advance. Refund only available unallocated credit/advance through a separately confirmed cash event and link it to its source. Do not offset customer credit against supplier debt automatically even when one identity has both roles.
alternatives_for_review: Keep supplier advances unavailable initially until a reviewed supplier workflow is agreed.
Any automatic customer/supplier offset requires a separate explicit policy.

decisions.proposed_rule: The proposed first finance scope records the gross EUR amount to be settled. Any net/VAT breakdown is an accountant-supplied immutable snapshot; the application does not infer a VAT rate, exemption, withholding or tax liability. No tax invoice issuance or automatic VAT calculation is supplied by this decision. Office fees/cash are separate from client myDATA turnover and tax forecasts.
alternatives_for_review: If automatic net/VAT calculation is required, approve supported regimes, rates, effective dates, invoice/credit-note rules and reference examples first.

decisions.proposed_rule: EUR postings/allocations/refunds use exact finite Decimal values in cents. Reject ordinary user-entered amounts with more than two fractional digits rather than silently round them. Derived line prices use ROUND_HALF_UP once at the posted line boundary; total the rounded lines. Show any allocation/proration residual for explicit resolution; never silently lose a cent. This is a proposed software convention, not an assertion of a statutory tax rule.
alternatives_for_review: Choose ROUND_HALF_EVEN or another accountant-approved line/total convention and replace the rounding examples.

decisions.proposed_rule: Version terms prospectively with effective date, actor and reason. Cancellation stops future charge occurrences from its approved cutoff but retains posted charges, allocations and cash. Reversing an existing charge is a separate explicit operation that releases its allocations into credit/advance. Cancellation alone never refunds money or erases a settled history.
alternatives_for_review: Define a different explicit treatment for already posted obligations; no automatic deletion or implicit refund is acceptable.

decisions.proposed_rule: Correct a posted item by a linked full reversal and an optional replacement in one transaction when requested together. Store business effective date separately from UTC recorded_at. The original remains effective in earlier as-of reports; its reversal takes effect on the reversal date. Backdating requires a reason and cannot precede the opening or enter a declared closed period. Future-dated cash and partial cash reversals are unavailable initially; a partial return uses the explicit refund workflow.
alternatives_for_review: Approve a different permitted correction-date/closed-period policy and update all as-of examples.

decisions.proposed_rule: Keep contractual lifecycle separate from derived settlement. No charges means NO_OBLIGATIONS, not paid. A fully billed one-off agreement with zero outstanding is displayed as completed; reversing settlement reopens its balance. A recurring contract may be settled to date while remaining active for future occurrences. CANCELLED lifecycle always remains cancelled, even if its posted debt is settled.
alternatives_for_review: Specify a different one-off/recurring completion rule without conflating the contract value, billed obligation and received cash.

decisions.proposed_rule: Retain current owner/accountant read-and-post access. Propose owner-only opening adjustments, release of posted allocations, refunds and linked reversals, with password/recent MFA, reason and audit. Recheck active office/user after lock waits. Add explicit capabilities in S18/S24 after this review; do not silently extend current finance.write. D01 must be updated for these new operations only after approval.
alternatives_for_review: Permit accountants as well as owners to perform named correction actions with the same proof/audit safeguards.

operations.title: Opening balance
operations.balance_effect: Establish account cash at the start of effective_date; no operating income/expense or client settlement.
operations.preconditions: One reviewed opening per account; no earlier movement; signed/negative opening needs D08-01 approval.
operations.correction: Before use correct the draft; after use post a linked opening adjustment with reason. Never import both a closing total and the same historic movements twice.

operations.title: Correct an established opening without rewriting it
operations.balance_effect: Cash changes by the approved signed delta on the adjustment date; operating income/expense, client charges and credit are unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Nonzero exact-cent delta backed by reviewed opening evidence; owner correction authority/proof; no closed/pre-opening date and no silent earlier as-of restatement.
operations.correction: Linked opposite adjustment and an explicit replacement when needed; retain the original opening and every adjustment. It is not an unexplained reconciliation shortcut.

operations.title: Create/activate agreement
operations.balance_effect: Terms only: cash, charges, credit and outstanding are unchanged until a separate charge is posted.
operations.preconditions: Receivable requires customer role; payable requires supplier role; counterparty is active and same office.
operations.correction: Amend terms prospectively with a new version or cancel future generation; retain every prior version.

operations.title: Post receivable/payable obligation
operations.balance_effect: Receivable or payable outstanding increases by amount; cash and credit do not change.
operations.preconditions: One source occurrence; active eligible counterparty; fixed currency/price and due/effective date; agreement terms never also count as a second charge.
operations.correction: Link a charge reversal/adjustment. Release its effective allocations atomically; retained cash becomes unallocated credit/advance.

operations.title: Record ordinary income
operations.balance_effect: Account cash increases by amount. If client-linked it initially becomes unallocated receipt credit; charge outstanding changes only through a separate allocation.
operations.preconditions: Positive cents; same office and active account/counterparty for new work; no future cash date; allocation confirmation is separate.
operations.correction: A full linked reversal releases allocations and restores the signed cash effect after explicitly reversing dependent refunds; use those dependency rules, not a negative ordinary receipt.

operations.title: Record ordinary expense
operations.balance_effect: Account cash decreases by amount. Supplier-linked cash initially becomes an unallocated supplier advance; payable outstanding changes only through allocation.
operations.preconditions: Same constraints as receipt, with payable direction. Overdraft behaviour follows the approved opening/account policy.
operations.correction: A full linked reversal releases its allocations and restores cash; supplier refund is a distinct incoming cash event.

operations.title: Allocate receipt/payment
operations.balance_effect: Outstanding and source unallocated credit/advance decrease by amount; cash does not change.
operations.preconditions: Lock cash sources and charges in stable ID order after office/user. Enforce amount <= source available and amount <= target outstanding, including concurrent requests.
operations.correction: Release a posted allocation through a linked dated event with actor/reason; do not edit/delete its original.

operations.title: Release allocation
operations.balance_effect: Outstanding and source unallocated credit/advance increase by the released amount; cash is unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Full release of an effective allocation; one release per original; recompute effective state under locks.
operations.correction: Reallocate through a new confirmed allocation. A receipt/charge reversal releases the relevant allocations in the same transaction.

operations.title: Refund client credit / receive supplier refund
operations.balance_effect: Client refund: cash and available receipt credit decrease. Supplier refund: cash increases and supplier advance decreases. Existing charges/settled allocations stay unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Bound by unallocated source credit/advance; same office/counterparty/currency/direction. A refund references specific source amounts, not a free balance total.
operations.correction: Linked refund reversal restores the consumed credit/advance and opposite cash effect. Reverse dependent refunds before reversing the original receipt/payment.

operations.title: Transfer between accounts
operations.balance_effect: Source cash decreases and destination cash increases equally; total office cash, operating income/expense, client charges and credit are unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Distinct active same-office EUR accounts; atomic paired source identity; no client/charge allocation on a transfer leg.
operations.correction: Reverse both legs together as a linked pair; correcting amount/accounts uses a new paired replacement, never editing one leg.

operations.title: Reverse a source-linked client/supplier refund
operations.balance_effect: Opposite signed cash effect of that refund; restore the consumed availability to its exact original receipt/payment sources; charge allocations/outstanding are unchanged.
operations.preconditions: One full reversal of the same-office original refund. Check source links and correction authority after lock waits; no unlinked income/expense shortcut.
operations.correction: If money is subsequently refunded again, create a new explicit source-linked refund; do not erase the original or recursively toggle its state.

operations.title: Reverse posted receipt/payment
operations.balance_effect: Reverse the original signed cash amount on reversal date; release its allocations and remove its own unallocated source credit/advance. Unrelated source balances remain unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Full reversal once, with same-office original. Dependent effective refunds must first be reversed in the same explicit correction group; no hidden negative credit. A second reversal is denied.
operations.correction: A replacement is a new immutable record. Correct a mistaken correction by a new explicit chain; no recursive arbitrary un-reversal in the first release.

operations.title: Reverse posted obligation
operations.balance_effect: Net obligation decreases by original amount. Release its allocations to the original receipt/payment sources. Cash is unchanged; money is refunded only by REFUND.
operations.preconditions: Full charge reversal once; do not manufacture cash or infer a statutory credit note. Preserve source link so generation does not silently recreate the charge.
operations.correction: New corrected charge with an explicit replacement relation; automatic recurrence/task retry cannot reuse the cancelled source occurrence.

operations.title: Change agreement terms
operations.balance_effect: Only future unposted occurrences use the new version; existing charges, cash, allocations and prices remain unchanged.
operations.preconditions: Explicit effective period and optimistic version. The old/new schedule cannot both produce the same office/agreement/period source key.
operations.correction: Another dated version, or an explicit posted-charge correction for an earlier error.

operations.title: Cancel/end future contract obligations
operations.balance_effect: Stop future generation from cutoff. Retain posted obligations, cash and allocations. CANCELLED stays cancelled whatever the settlement balance.
operations.preconditions: Respect the reviewed service-period cutoff. A full settled agreement cancellation alone leaves cash and outstanding unchanged.
operations.correction: No silent reactivation. A replacement agreement/version or explicit charge/cash reversal needs reviewed history and source identity.

operations.title: Generate due monthly charge
operations.balance_effect: One posted charge per due source occurrence; no receipt/payment. A scheduled agreement amount is not another obligation.
operations.preconditions: Check active schedule, cancellation cutoff, reviewed first/last amount, office/client authority at execution, and unique period independent of schedule version.
operations.correction: Correct by a linked reversal and explicit replacement/waiver; retry must observe the existing source outcome.

operations.title: Confirm billable task charge
operations.balance_effect: Create one charge after explicit price confirmation; task completion alone does not create cash or an unreviewed fee.
operations.preconditions: Same office/counterparty and active task; immutable description/price snapshot and one task/source charge.
operations.correction: Linked charge reversal retaining the task and source identity; repeat completion/confirmation does not duplicate billing.

terms.notes: Amendment is a new terms version while ACTIVE. ENDED/CANCELLED do not auto-reactivate; financial settlement is an independent projection.

charge.notes: Settlement OPEN/PARTIAL/SETTLED is derived from dated allocations and releases, not an editable charge amount.

cash.notes: Transfer/refund is an explicit kind. REVERSED is current metadata; historical reports retain original and reversal effects by date.

allocation.notes: Release is a linked dated event; no deletion. New allocation after release has a new ID.

rules: Posted positive obligation exists and outstanding == 0 => SETTLED.
CANCELLED lifecycle is never overwritten by any settlement projection.
A recurring agreement settled to date remains eligible for future due occurrences while ACTIVE.

unsupported_until_reviewed: Multi-currency, FX, bank reconciliation/feeds, statutory general ledger and tax invoice/credit-note issuance.
Automatic VAT/withholding/tax calculation or use of office fee receipts as client myDATA turnover.
Automatic proration, due days 29–31 or non-calendar billing anchors until their exact rules are approved.
Automatic cross-direction customer/supplier offset, cash overdraft limits and supplier advances if D08-04 is changed.
Partial cash reversals, future-dated cash, recursive un-reversal and silent reopening of cancelled agreements.
Live legacy migration, closed-period administration and accountant-approved reconciliation (S25/S31); a declared closed period is a required future guard, not an implemented feature.
Actual job execution, recurring charge generation and exports: their later steps must implement and test this contract.
